_comment: Hand-judged matches for calibrating the similarity cutoff. 'good' means a local analyst would plausibly investigate this pairing -- not that it is comparable, which is a separate human grade. NYC rows are the verified pairs from crosswalk.json; the rest were judged by reading the candidate lists. Labels are contestable: edit and re-run `python3 probe/calibrate.py`.
